name: RU-28306
summary: RU-28306, also known as UCD0094 or as 4,α-methylene-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (4,α-methylene-DMT), is a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist as well as dopamine receptor agonist. It is a cyclized tryptamine, specifically a conformationally restricted tricyclic derivative of dimethyltryptamine (DMT), and can also be considered a partial ergoline or simplified and deconstructed analogue of LSD.

pharmacology.text: RU-28306 shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor (Ki = 329 nM) and 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 41–314 nM in different assays). Its affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was almost 2-fold higher than that of dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and 7-fold lower than that of LSD. The drug acts as a potent partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT1 and 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Dopamine D2 receptor agonist; Simplified/partial LSD analogue
